candidate.derivedAnswer: A: 200 km; Plan A produces fewer emissions for x>200 km.
candidate.answerReason: The comparison 30+0.1x<0.25x is equivalent to x>200. At 200 km the plans have equal emissions, so choice A gives the threshold.

methods.label: Compare the emissions expressions
methods.explanation: Let the distance traveled be \(x\) km. For A to produce fewer emissions, \(30+0.1x<0.25x\), so \(0.15x>30\), giving \(x>200\). Thus, A produces fewer emissions when the distance exceeds 200 km.
methods.levelReason: Forming and solving the comparison requires only Grade 7 expressions and linear inequalities.
